subject.title: fix(gmail): stop watcher when OAuth renewal is invalid

question: Should this compatibility-sensitive fail-closed watcher change require live Gog/Gmail proof for both terminal OAuth and transient failure paths before merge, or should a maintainer explicitly override that gate?
rationale: Mocks establish the intended branches but cannot prove the real Gog error text, process termination, timer cleanup, or operator-visible behavior with actual credentials.

options.title: Require two-path live proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output or logs showing revoked credentials stop the watcher and a transient network failure does not stop it.

options.title: Use a maintainer proof override
options.body: A maintainer may manually validate and explicitly override the external real-behavior gate if live Gmail credentials cannot safely be exercised in the PR.

recommendation.title: Require two-path live proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output or logs showing revoked credentials stop the watcher and a transient network failure does not stop it.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature history ties the original Gmail webhook lifecycle most directly to this author.
